# RobPaasPoker

> Rob Paas is a professional online tournament poker player and Twitch streamer based in London, Ontario, Canada. robpaaspoker.com tracks his 2026 "Road to $100K" profit goal day by day, and every tournament he has logged.

Figures as of November 17, 2026, updated automatically after each session:

- 2026 profit: +$93,612 toward a $100,000 goal (Canadian dollars, US-dollar rooms counted at 1.35), $5.9K ahead of pace
- 148 days and 1,320.4 hours played, +$71 per hour
- Tournaments logged in Canadian-dollar rooms: 894, net +$8,065, ROI +8%, in the money 17.5% of buy-ins
- Tournaments logged in US-dollar rooms: 353, net +US$29,047, ROI +94.4%, in the money 18.9% of buy-ins

## Pages

- [Road to $100K](https://robpaaspoker.com/Roadto$100k/): 2026 profit by day, month and poker site, with a calendar linking every session
- [Tournament results](https://robpaaspoker.com/results/): every logged tournament, with ROI and in-the-money rate by site, stake and tournament
- [About](https://robpaaspoker.com/about/): who Rob is and how he plays
- [Play & Study](https://robpaaspoker.com/app/): Rob's free Windows poker software: table tiler, HUD, hand tracker and study tools
